The purging of piping systems shall be in accordance with the provisions of Sections 406.7.1.1 through 406.7.1.4 where the piping system meets either of the following:
   1.   The design operating gas pressure is greater than 2 psig (13.8 kPa).
   2.   The piping being purged contains one or more sections of pipe meeting the size and length criteria of Table 406.7.1.1.
